title: Quick Crunchy Venezuelan Khus Khus Empanadas
description: Fresh crunchy empanadas filled with khus khus, featuring a lamination puff pastry, perfect for a romantic Venezuelan dish, gluten free friendly.
instructions: Roll out the lamination puff pastry to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles of pastry using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a tablespoon of toasted and ground khus khus seeds in the center of each pastry circle.
Fold the pastry in half over the filling to form a half moon shape, and press the edges together to seal.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with beaten egg for a golden glaze.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle with vegetable oil and sprinkle with salt and sugar.
Bake for 20 minutes or until golden brown.
